subject: [hw] DONE V33 rev 8
body:
Rev 8: F18 follow-up only. The /data,/sdcard -> $N2HW_DUMP_DIR mapping now refuses guest paths containing a "." or ".." component, so the dump tree cannot be escaped (/data/../../etc/passwd is ENOENT). 327 checks.

  N2TEST V33-TABLE PASS 27/27
  N2TEST V33-HOOK PASS 10/10
  N2TEST V33 PASS 327/327   (ASan+UBSan -O1, plain -O2, TSan -O1)

Rev 7-s main fix stands: no host file is reachable from guest code except below the dump dir.
